values.note: $15 per site per night, paid at the self-service fee station (the Forest Service page also carries a stale 'Single Site: $10 per night' line).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351738 ('Campsites are $15 per night.') + /rates (First-come, First-served Season, WalkInSingle 15) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/tea-creek-campground ('Camping fee is $15.00 per site per night, payable at the camping self-service fee station.'; also 'Single Site: $10 per night') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/newsroom/releases/monongahela-increasing-and-adding-fees-several-developed (December 5, 2025: 'Tea Creek Campground Single Site Fee: $15' from January 1, 2026), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First come, first served: recreation.gov lists the 28 sites as not reservable and only a walk-in rate. Pay at the self-service fee station. Check-out 2 p.m.; limit 2 vehicles per campsite.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351738/rates (only a 'First-come, First-served Season' walk-in rate) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10351738 (all 28 sites reservable: false) + recreation.gov notice 'Limit 2 vehicles per campsite' + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/tea-creek-campground ('Maximum length of stay is 14 days.', 'Check-out time is 2:00 p.m.', 'payable at the camping self-service fee station'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351738 (notice 'No RV hookups are available') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (every site STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 28 gravel sites in two loops: the upper loop has 18, the lower 10. recreation.gov lists every site back-in, with driveways of 30-89 ft (most 40-65).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/tea-creek-campground ('Tea Creek has two loops, an upper loop which has 18 sites ... The lower loop has 10 sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351738 ('a spacious 28-site campground', 'Campsites are gravel') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (Driveway Entry Back-in on all 28, Driveway Length 30-89), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Vault toilets and a hand pump for potable water, both seasonal. Three bear-proof trash cages.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351738 ('There are vault toilets and a handpump for potable water') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/tea-creek-campground ('Vault toilets are available seasonally at this site.', 'Potable water is available seasonally at this site.', 'three bear-proof trash cages'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 openings: sites 19-28 on April 13, sites 1-18 on April 20 ('dates are subject to change based on local weather conditions'); no closing date published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation (2026 Recreation Opening Dates: 'Tea Creek Campground Campsites #1-18 – 4/20', 'Campsites #19-28 – 4/13'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bridge replacement since August 28, 2026: crews are replacing the campground bridge over the Williams River, and 'the existing bridge and campground will remain open for the duration of the project' with an active work zone near the entrance.

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/tea-creek-campground-construction-alert ('Crews are replacing the Tea Creek Campground bridge over the Williams River. While the existing bridge and campground will remain open for the duration of the project, visitors will experience an active construction work zone near the campground entrance.', alert start August 12, 2026, no end date), read 2026-10-21

note: High-elevation campground at the intersection of the Williams River and Tea Creek; spacious layout with a few sites right on the river or the creek.  --AWH

awh_superseded.old: High-elevation campground at the intersection of the Williams River and Tea Creek; spacious 28-site layout with a few sites right on the river or the creek.  --AWH
awh_superseded.source: redundant: sites.count (only '28-site' dropped; rest kept verbatim)

summary: recreation.gov + Forest Service page + 2026 fee release: confirmed $15/night and no hookups; added first-come only (not reservable on rec.gov), 14-day limit, 28 back-in gravel sites (18 upper/10 lower), seasonal vault toilets and hand-pump water, 2026 openings April 13/20, and status open during the Williams River bridge replacement. Not stated: rig length limit (driveways 30-89 ft), closing date. Note: dropped '28-site' (sites.count).
flags: Road closure (not a campground closure): Forest Order 09-21-02-26-04 closes the active construction segments of FR 86 (Williams River Road) from July 8 through November 30, 2026; the Forest Service says FR 86 is closed from FR 216 to WV 150 in phases, with Tea Creek reached by alternative routes 'from Dyer, WV from the west' (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/forest-road-86-be-closed-construction-and-repair). The campground's own access is 1 mile in from WV 150 on FR 86.
Missing phone: Marlinton-White Sulphur Ranger District (304) 799-4334 (recreation.gov facility phone and the construction alert).
Missing agency website: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/tea-creek-campground (entry's website is only the recreation.gov page).

Fee line conflict on the Forest Service page itself: 'Single Site: $10 per night' beside 'Camping fee is $15.00 per site per night'; recreation.gov and the 2026 fee release both say $15, which is recorded.
